top_signals.title: Chris Wright Says Diesel Exports From Arabian Gulf Likely to Increase
top_signals.summary: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that he expects diesel prices to be 'dropped significantly' but will need increased exports out of the Arabian Gulf to manage it amid the ongoing war with Iran. Wright also Russia's diesel output, saying that the only way Russia can benefit from recently permitted exports of diesel is to deliver a ceasefire on energy or end the war.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed Will Raise Rates in December, Clarida Predicts
top_signals.summary: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida expects the Fed to raise rates in December and then possibly again in March. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Discord to let search engines index public server messages
top_signals.summary: Discord will allow search engines to index discussions in Discoverable Servers and make them accessible on the web to users outside the platform without an account or invitation. [...]
